title: DumpagentUpdateManifest
description: Update manifest consumed by the dumpagent edge agent update check / self-update client. Published per-channel to Cloudflare R2 (dumpagent/<channel>/latest.json) and as an immutable per-version copy (dumpagent/<version>/release.json). manifest.version is the release version (e.g. v0.1.0), distinct from the git tag (dumpagent-go-v0.1.0), which is the tag minus the dumpagent-go- prefix.

schema_version.description: Manifest schema major version. Clients must refuse a value they do not recognize rather than attempt to parse it.

channel.description: Release channel this manifest was published under. Self-identifying so a manifest copied to the wrong R2 key is detectable.

version.description: Release version, e.g. v0.1.0 or v0.1.0-rc.1. Must be byte-identical to main.Version in the built binary.

released_at.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp of publication. Used for forensics and to detect a stale or stuck manifest.

min_supported_version.description: Lowest agent version allowed to auto-update from. Agents below this version have a breaking config or protocol change and must follow the manual install runbook instead of self-updating.

release_notes_url.description: URL to the GitHub Release notes for this version, surfaced in agent logs.

artifacts.description: Per-platform download artifacts. A map (not a flat field) so adding a new os-arch is additive.

url.description: Primary download URL, served from the public R2 distribution domain.

fallback_url.description: Fallback download URL, the GitHub Release asset. Used if the R2 primary is unreachable.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the artifact, verified before install/self-update.

size.description: Artifact size in bytes. Used to pre-allocate and detect a truncated download.
